description: Generate a high-quality sound effect (MP3) from a text description — cinematic hits, Foley, ambience, loops, musical elements.
summary: Text-to-sound-effects: describe the sound ('Heavy wooden door creaking open', 'Atmospheric synth pad') and set duration_seconds (0.5–30, required — it is the billing basis). Output is MP3 base64 (audio_base64). Priced $0.12 per minute of generated audio, prorated per second.

text.description: Description of the sound effect (e.g. 'Glass shattering on concrete', '90s hip-hop drum loop, 90 BPM'). Sequences and audio terminology (whoosh, braam, drone) work well.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the generated effect in seconds (0.5–30). REQUIRED — it is the exact billing basis ($0.12 per minute, prorated per second).

prompt_influence.description: 0–1 (default 0.3): higher = follows the prompt more literally; lower = more creative variation.

body.description: Generate a sound effect from a text description

variants.label: Text to Sound v2 — per minute of generated audio

notes: Generated audio is saved on Monid cloud with a default 7-day retention; the run output carries an `audio` object with a fresh signed download_link (valid ~1h — re-fetch the run for a new one), content_type and link/file expiries. To keep the file past retention, download it via the link and re-upload with the sfs /put endpoint; after retention the object reads { expired: true }. audio_base64 appears inline only if the save failed.
duration_seconds is REQUIRED and is billed exactly (no auto-duration mode — deterministic billing).
Output is MP3 44.1kHz 128kbps, returned base64-encoded in the run output (audio_base64). Set loop: true for seamless loops.
